fire: Pickers were paid $8 to $9 a day (roughly 650 to 730 pesos) during the harvest.
Each hive holds between 20 and 30 frames, so the apiary produces around 400 to 600 kilograms a year.
A room costs 40 to 55 pounds per night (about $50 to $70) in summer.
The seedlings need 15 to 20 millimetres of water a week (0.6 to 0.8 inches).
Drivers earn 300 to 350 dirhams per shift (around $80 to $95) plus tips.
Each sack weighs between 45 and 50 kilos, so a truckload comes to about 9 to 10 tonnes.
The loan carried interest of 12 to 14 percent (1.0 to 1.2 percent a month).
